notes: WhaleChat 3.59.0 — lock-screen push notifications are back: the Cloudflare sync worker now signs VAPID requests, encrypts payloads (aes128gcm) and delivers every new chat or session message to the recipient's registered devices. Live market quotes are restored too: the worker serves 120 stock, ETF, FX and crypto quotes from the public Yahoo Finance feed with a 30-second refresh, SSE streaming and historical sparklines, so watchlists, holdings and charts move again. Chat remains local-first and realtime.
